contea di ritrovamento: Wiltshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CAESAR TRAIAN HADRIANVS AVG ; R/ P M TR P COS III

A Roman silver denarius of Hadrian (AD 117-138) dating from AD 119-121. Mint of Rome. RIC II, p.352, no.101. Dimensions: diameter: 18.88mm; weight: 3.04g. Obverse description: Laureate bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP CAESAR TRAIAN HADRIANVS AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing right holding trophy with both hands. Reverse inscription: P M TR P COS III
